name: Campanario (Spain)
description: Vertically divided red and white in the proportions 1:2, charged over the division with the crowned municipal arms of Campanario (a cross of Alcántara and a tower on white and red).
history: Municipal flag of Campanario; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Campanario arms — cross of Alcántara and tower
